rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１９Sorry to drop in on your day￥off. Got a minute?
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０２０Your scores have dropped a lot.￥Are you okay?＝＠０２９＿０２１This is a really important time,￥so you probably shouldn't think￥about anything but the exams.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０２２One bad slump can end up￥affecting your overall results,￥you know!
Is that so?
Mind your own business.
Is that so?
Mind your own business.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０２３Yes, it is!＝＠０２９＿０２４You don't seem all that￥interested in the exams, but...＝＠０２９＿０２５with that attitude, I don't￥think you deserve to be a￥candidate.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０２６Oh...￥Sorry, I don't mean it badly...￥But it's the truth.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０２７What are you talking about?!＝＠０２９＿０２８I'm only telling you this￥because you don't realize the￥position you're in!!
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０２９Do you even realize you're a￥candidate?
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿００１Listen, everyone here came￥because they seriously want to￥go to Elan!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿００２I never thought someone as￥halfhearted as you would￥be here!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿００３Honestly, not even trying is an￥insult to everyone else!!
No need to go that far.
You're right. My bad.
No need to go that far.
You're right. My bad.
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿００４Sorry, but you're the one￥making me say it!＝＠０２７＿００５I don't want to say this￥stuff either, but...
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿００６If you really think so, then￥get your act together!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿００７If you really want to go to￥Elan, you need to buckle down￥and try harder.
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿００８Otherwise, how can you face the￥people who chose you as a￥candidate?
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿００９Okay, I'm expecting good results￥on the next exam, got it?!
